name: PEG-8 cocoate
description: PEG-8 Cocoate (CAS 61791-29-5 ), also known commercially as fatty acids, coco, ethoxylated, is a coconut-derived ethoxylated ester used across formulation and industrial processing. It functions primarily as an emulsifier, surfactant, and mild cleansing agent in both rinse-off and leave-on systems. In personal care, it emulsifies oil-in-water systems in lotions and creams. It is also used in conditioning hair products, contributing mild moisturizing properties that support skin feel without heavy residue. Home care formulators incorporate it into liquid detergents. It is effective in hard surface cleaners where low-irritation surfactancy and grease dispersion are required. Textile and leather processors use it as an emulsifier and lubricant aid. It is frequently utilized in fiber treatment baths and finishing formulations. In agrochemical concentrates, it supports emulsification of oil-based active ingredients into stable spray-ready dispersions. PEG-8 Cocoate is supplied as an amber to yellow liquid or semi-solid, depending on temperature and ethoxylation degree. It is available in technical and cosmetic grades for various uses. Cosmetic-grade material typically meets relevant purity benchmarks for personal care use. Bulk supply is standard in drums and IBCs, with some suppliers offering kosher or RSPO-certified variants. These variants are aligned to sustainable sourcing requirements. The material remains a versatile choice for formulators seeking reliable emulsification and mildness in diverse chemical applications.
